incidents.explanation: Bus C1 had an engine warning light reported at 06:50 (medium severity) and was later observed stationary between stops from 07:19, consistent with a mechanical breakdown.

plans_considered.plan: Replace broken-down bus: spare S1 with driver D11 from the depot, at Newtown, King St by 07:36

decision.summary: Replace broken-down bus: spare S1 with driver D11 from the depot, at Newtown, King St by 07:36
decision.reason: Bus S1 is accessible, ensuring the wheelchair passenger at Newtown King St is served fairly, and driver D11 has a later shift end providing operational resilience and avoiding fatigue risks.

service_alerts.description_text: A Route C bus has broken down mechanically and is stationary between stops. A replacement bus is en route. expected about 07:36 at Newtown, King St, Stanmore, Parramatta Rd, Petersham and Marrickville Metro.

lessons.summary: Route A runs about 14 min late on rainy mornings; an early extra bus keeps the gap down.

agents.name: Monitor
agents.role: Code. Watches positions and feeds every 2 min; raises incidents

agents.name: PreCheck
agents.role: Start of morning: today's conditions + memory -> act before delays

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Nemotron. Chooses Zetaris tools, explains WHY with cited evidence

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Code computes options; Nemotron picks one and explains

agents.name: SafetyCritic
agents.role: Hard rules in code + Nemotron review; can block and send back

agents.name: Notifier
agents.role: Nemotron (small). Passenger service alerts + controller decision card

agents.name: Learner
agents.role: End of morning: writes lessons to H-MEM
